title: Unique view of the mountains
text: Really packed and balanced morning with the horse riding being such a unique way to view the mountains. Loved it!
author: Kristi_B

title: I had a great time! My...
text:
I had a great time! My favorite things were: 
- the small group setting (ended up being 7 - and it was all girls so it turned into a cute girls trip)
- The ranch. Very sweet ranch owners. I appreciate them for opening up their space to us. NOTE - please respect the space and do not take photos until you are told it is ok. 🙂
- The History & Walk. I hit 15K steps this day, learned a lot, and was grateful to be in the spiritual space of a very unique Monastery (in my opinion). 
- The outside market and souvenir shops are differently worth the gander
author: Imani_R

title: my very first guided tour
text:
At first I was a bit hesitant booking a guided tour on my own, but it turned out to be a wonderful experience.
Everything was well organised and in the small group there were plenty of possibilities to get in touch with new people from around the world.
Our guide David was very knowledgeable and funny. He created a good atmosphere and gave good recommendations for other spots in Barcelona.
Overall the trip was an enjoyable mix of riding, hiking and sightseeing.
The only criticism could be, that it should have been much longer :D
No prior skills needed - even newbies like me did it!
author: GoPlaces35101380911

title: Great day trip!
text: We had an excellent time on this tour. Juan our tour guide was very knowledgeable and shared a lot of information about Barcelona and its history. The horseback riding was fun with some beautiful views. The Monastery of Montserrat and its surrounding area was stunning. Our family of five all agreed that this was the highlight of our trip.
author: 869oonan

title: This was such a fun and...
text: This was such a fun and unique day trip! The mountains were breathtaking and our guide was extremely informative and kind. The horseback riding was super fun! The guides there were so helpful and reassuring as some of us in the group had never even ridden a horse. Truly a wonderful time!
author: Krystle_I

title: An unforgettable memory
text:
I want to start with a big “thank you!!” 
It has been a wonderful experience, surrounded by nature and good feelings that I will never forget. 
Thank you Frank for joining us on this experience and sharing your knowledge about the history and legends of this lovely place. 
The horseback riding route has been relaxing and suitable for everyone, including those who never rode a horse. 
Super recommended!!
author: giuliasP294EW

title: Amazing tour of a beautiful part of Spain.
text: Had a fantastic time on this trip to Montserrat with horse riding. Our guide Frank was lovely and looked after us very well - he knew a lot about the monastery. The horses looked well looked after and the views on the trek were stunning. Transport was comfortable and air conditioned. If I had more time in Barcelona I would definitely go again! Thank you
author: laurenoT7957CD

title: Stunning views everywhere you go.
text: This journey was an amazing time. I went with my sisters and girlfriend and had a blast. The horseback riding was amazing with beautiful views of Monserrat mountain the whole time. The monastery was also amazing with beautiful views of the valley and mountains.
author: Jonathon_H

title: Great views and gentle horses
text: Our guide, Juan, was super nice and helpful. The horses were gentle and well taken care of. This is a great choice for anyone looking for a nice relaxing trail ride through the beautiful Catalonian countryside followed by a visit to one of the most stunning gothic basilicas out there.
author: alexandrabI133AH

title: Breathtaking Montserrat
text: The horses are well cared for and trained well. The view of the mountain while riding is breathtaking. Juan was an amazing guide. Very knowledgeable and pleasant.
author: Ric_F
